question: Indian athlete Joshna Chinappa represents the country in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**squash**__.

__
 
• **Indian athlete Joshna Chinappa represents the country in squash.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Joshna Chinappa:**

 
 
• She represents India in squash.
 
• She is the **youngest Indian women's national champion. **
 
• She is also the **first Indian to win the British Junior Squash Championship title in **2005 in the **under-19 category.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a44b9c169d07267e746abdf9b0b39522e9d593f4e7fc3bb92b5ebbad13de4929.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Terminologies used in Squash are boast, nick, striker, tight, and tin.**
 
• **Kamalpreet Kaur** is associated with** discus throw.**
 
• **Thoudam Kalpana Devi **is associated with **Judo**.
